title: 第1章 重生了第2章 玉佩金手指
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道眼神呆滞，看着桌上摆放的两张黑白遗像，久久无法言语。
就在不久前这具身体的原主，接受不了父母双亡的现实，选择服安眠药自杀了。
死的很草率。
原主死亡瞬间，林道无缝衔接穿越到这具身体上。
而且原主也名林道。
开局就死父母，这是主角的命格吗？
要不要这么刺激！
满脸懵逼的林道，心情久久无法平静。
自己上一世996。
劳累过度，得了绝症，带着强烈的不甘，三十岁都不到就英年早逝。
原主才18岁就想不开，这丫旱的旱死涝的涝死。
忽着脑袋传来一阵剧烈的疼痛，令林道险些无法稳定身形。
大量陌生的记忆强行涌进林道脑海里。
过了好一会儿，疼痛才减轻些。
就在林道刚刚缓过劲时。
门外就响起轻轻地叩门声！
这是不给一点心理准备的吗？
林道眼神一变，表情慌乱，毕竟现在自己可不是原装货。
难保不被人看出端倪来，尤其是熟人。
“少爷，你睡着了吗”门外传来有些苍老的声音。

怕什么来什么，这声音他认得，根据原主的记忆，这是管家福伯的声音。
管家福伯可是原主家里的老人，一直对男主照顾有加。
自己现在可不能慌，不然极有可能会露出端倪。
林道强行镇定道：“福伯我还没睡，有事吗？”。
不行得先打发走，给自己一些缓冲的时间。
门外传来福伯苍老而低沉的声音“少爷是关于老爷与夫人遗嘱的事。”
林道脸上一愣，心里寻思这件事可是大事，推脱不了。
林道深呼吸一口气，让自己冷静，既然躲避不了。
那就面对，上天给了重生的机会，那就好好珍惜，现在自己就是原主。
林道连忙正襟危坐，沉声道：“福伯进来吧！”
房门打开，从门外走进位满头白发苍苍，身形挺拔，身穿黑色丧服的老人。
福伯一进房间。
就不着痕迹，四下打量一番。
而后怔怔看着眼前少爷，心里也不由松了口气。
他比任何人都清楚，自己这位从小看着长大的少爷，内心远比旁人更敏感脆弱的多。
再加上性子偏激。
又经此噩耗，极有可能走向极端。
福伯不知道自己看人还挺准的。
福伯收敛心神，从手上拿出已经有些陈旧的遗嘱，递给自家少爷。
林道看着眼前有些陈旧的遗嘱，心头猛地不由一酸。
content_en:
Lin Dao's eyes were dull, looking at the two black and white portraits placed on the table, he was speechless for a long time.
Not long ago, the original owner of this body could not accept the reality that his parents had died and chose to commit suicide by taking sleeping pills.
It was a hasty death.
At the moment of the original owner's death, Lin Dao seamlessly traveled to this body.
And the original owner was also named Lin Dao.
His parents die at the beginning. Is this the fate of the protagonist?
Wouldn’t it be so exciting!
Lin Dao, whose face was full of confusion, could not calm down for a long time.
996 in my previous life.
Overworked, terminally ill, and with a strong sense of unwillingness, he died young before he was thirty.
The original owner was only 18 years old and couldn't figure it out. This girl was dying of drought and flooding.
Suddenly, a sharp pain came from his head, making Lindao almost unable to stabilize his body.
A large number of unfamiliar memories forced their way into Lin Dao's mind.
After a while, the pain eased.
Just when Lin Dao had just recovered his strength.
There was a gentle knock on the door!
Isn’t this without some mental preparation?
Lin Dao's eyes changed and his expression was flustered. After all, he was not the original product now.
It's hard to guarantee that someone won't notice it, especially an acquaintance.
"Master, are you asleep?" An old voice came from outside the door.
No matter what he was afraid of, he recognized this voice. According to the memory of the original owner, it was the voice of Butler Fu Bo.
The housekeeper Fu Bo is an old man in the original owner's family and has always taken good care of the male protagonist.
I can't panic now, otherwise clues will most likely be revealed.
Lin Dao forced himself to calm down and said, "Uncle Fu, I haven't slept yet. Is something wrong?".
If it doesn't work, you have to send it away first and give yourself some buffer time.
Uncle Fu's old and deep voice came from outside the door, "Master, this is about the will of the master and his wife."
Lin Dao was stunned for a moment, thinking that this matter was a big deal and he couldn't shirk it.
Lindao took a deep breath to calm himself down, since he couldn't avoid it.
Then face it, God has given you the opportunity to be reborn, then cherish it, now you are the original owner.
Lin Dao quickly sat upright and said in a deep voice: "Uncle Fu, come in!"
The door opened, and an old man with white hair and a tall figure wearing black mourning clothes walked in.
As soon as Fu Bo entered the room.
Just leave no trace and look around.
Then he stared blankly at the young master in front of him, and couldn't help but feel relieved.
He knew better than anyone else that the young master he had grown up with was far more sensitive and fragile than others.
Coupled with his extreme temperament.
And after this bad news, it is very likely to go to extremes.
Uncle Fu didn't know that he was pretty good at reading people.
Uncle Fu gathered his thoughts, took out the somewhat old will from his hand, and handed it to his young master.
Lin Dao looked at the somewhat old will in front of him, and his heart suddenly felt sour.
